title: Dr. John York on Jed York's legal issue: "That's been resolved"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dr. John York on Jed York's legal issue: "That's been resolved"
sources.description: Last week, the non-stop NFL news cycle was briefly dominated by the arrest, and prompt no-contest plea, of 49ers owner Jed York on misdemeanor charges arising from a prostitution appointment that turned out to be a sting operation.
